0.original: Amidst the sadness of Alphinaud's countenance, there is a newfound determination.

25.original: Speak with Alphinaud and have him accompany you.

26.original: Speak with Alisaie while accompanied by Alphinaud and have them accompany you.

27.original: Follow the crystalline path while accompanied by Alphinaud and Alisaie, and speak with Alphinaud at the designated location.

49.original: That crystalline path─G'raha has paved it for us.

50.original: Difficult as it is, we must carry on. For our friends, and all who await us in faith.

51.original: So come, let us seek the path's beginning. It appears to be near the outpost.

52.original: I won't let it break me, don't you worry. I never have, and I never will.

54.original: It will surely deliver us true. It must.

56.original: Look up, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. It's as though the stars are being devoured by the dead sun...

57.original: And that's where we're headed─into the maw of darkness.

58.original: Well, here is where the path begins. And it ascends to dizzying heights...

59.original: Let us make our way, one sure step at a time.

64.original: Now more than ever, we must walk as one. Will you go and take Alisaie's hand?

65.original: Are you sure you wish to part ways with your companions?

66.original: Forgotten something, have you? Very well, we'll be waiting by the portal.

67.original: Aye, let us press on. One sure step at a time, till we win through to Meteion.

68.original: Your companions have yet to arrive. Be sure they are at your side before attempting to continue.

69.original: We should keep moving. Go and tell Alphinaud, will you?

70.original: You should have Alphinaud accompanying you before setting forth.

71.original: Our friends got us this far. Their courage, their strength. Their wisdom. Their love.

72.original: We owe it to them to continue. No matter how long it takes...

73.original: Alphinaud and Alisaie are now accompanying you. Keep them at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.

74.original: You can leave your quest companions behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with them and selecting the option to part ways.

75.original: If you wish to have your companions join you again, return and speak with them at the original location.

81.original: Should you start to fall, we'll be here to catch you. I know you'll do the same for us.

82.original: Alisaie appears to have fallen behind... We had best head back and fetch her.

83.original: G'raha paved this path for us. We were meant to follow it.

84.original: Where did Alphinaud disappear to now? We need to turn around and look for him.

85.original: We understand, take what time you need. When you're ready to continue, we'll be waiting by the portal.

86.original: If you're ready, then so am I. Let's follow the path where it leads!

87.original: The innumerable lights that shine in the distance─to think that they all could have birthed civilizations...

88.original: To think that everything they built has gone to dust, their peoples lost to despair... Of the stars floating in this sea of midnight, ours is a lonely aberration.

89.original: And yet...no matter how many worlds have met their ends, with you and Alisaie beside me, there is nothing I fear. No ocean so vast I cannot cross.

90.original: Those broken stars I see─shattered, ruptured, unraveled─I wonder if they're also worlds recreated at their ends...

91.original: The sight of them fills me with a sorrow I cannot describe...and a truth I cannot deny.

92.original: Birth...and death. Whence we came and where we'll return. A wheel from which there is no escape.

93.original: ...Thancred would scout the road ahead. Y'shtola and Urianger would trade opinions on esoteric subjects.

94.original: G'raha would join in their discussion, or else chat with me and Alisaie about the mission. Estinien would be at the rear, apart yet present.

95.original: All the while you would come and go. Wherever you are needed. And together, we would travel...

96.original: All I can hear are my footfalls. My heartbeat. It's so much quieter now...

97.original: But the fact we can breathe and continue on is proof that the others are still with us.

98.original: They are... They are... Aren't they...?

99.original: The portal is barely visible from up here.

100.original: ...Truly, we've come far. Much farther than would have been possible had we kept chasing perfect ideals as we did in the past.

101.original: It is because we have known failure and frustration─that we have learned and grown from them─that Hydaelyn has entrusted us with this mission. With the fate of the very star.

102.original: It's all a dream, isn't it...? A long, elaborate dream...

103.original: Any moment now, I'll wake up in my bed. Still a student. Grandfather alive. I'd go about my day, relieved as the fragments of that other life fade away...

104.original: And that would be happiness...wouldn't it? That none of it... No. No, I won't give up these experiences. Good and bad, they are mine. They are <hex:021A020203>me<hex:021A020103>.

105.original: Rest assured I am fine...but thank you for your concern. What of yourself? Though we can't afford to be too leisurely, neither need we rush unduly.

106.original: We've crossed an impossible distance to stand where we are now, and we're but a few steps away from journey's end. It will be over before we know it.

107.original: Me...? Oh, I still have plenty of legs left in me, don't you worry. It's you I'm worried about.

108.original: You always push yourself so hard for us─for everyone. And while we're here, we'll make sure to bear our share of the burden.

109.original: Well, this is it. The end of the path, and the beginning of whatever awaits.

110.original: There will be greater hardships. We may be made to feel powerless.

111.original: Yet come what may, let us have no regrets. No, let us have pride in what we have achieved.

112.original: In what we achieved, and how it changed us for the better... That's worth fighting for. And dying for. As they did...

113.original: There are some structures up ahead. Still a ways to go before we reach the dead sun...

114.original: Given...all this...I know how naive it must sound to hope it all works out somehow.

115.original: Still, you'll forgive me if I wish for it all the same. And for you most of all.

116.original: Not that you of all people need it. It's just...after all the help you've given me, for once I want to be the one to help you.

117.original: Of all the recreated worlds we've seen, this one feels the most familiar...

118.original: You should have Alisaie accompanying you before continuing.

120.original: Normal? It's not unlike many cities we know. But it's deathly quiet...

121.original: Mayhap the inhabitants are within the buildings. Or invisible to our senses.

122.original: (-???-)Wrong on both counts. There is simply no one here.

124.original: This is how I found it when I arrived. Another star which once pulsed with life, but no longer.

125.original: How it ended, I do not know. Invasion, sickness, suicide─none can say.

126.original: None lived to speak for the dead. They are gone. Gone. Search all you like, but you'll only end up turning back.

127.original: If what Meteion says is true, what are we supposed to do...?

128.original: If there is no one here, then neither should there be emotion to bar our way.

129.original: Yet Meteion seems convinced we'll turn back. What riddle is this...?
